extracted.intended_audience: readers, booksellers, librarians, and reviewers interested in horror/speculative short fiction (debut short-story collections)
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluative and promotional criteria for a debut short-story collection in horror/speculative fiction, as presented on a publisher product page; emphasizes qualities reviewers highlight (form, voice, themes, prose, cohesion, emotional effect).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form consciousness / formal awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: "irreverent and very conscious of form"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers praise work that shows deliberate attention to narrative form and structure; implies experiments with form that serve the stories rather than distract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warmth and wit when handling cruel material
rubrics_metrics.description: "connect to some of the cruelest portions of the human experience with uncommon warmth and wit."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective stories balance difficult subject matter with humane, witty perspective—evoking empathy rather than only shock or despair.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality / memorability
rubrics_metrics.description: "one of the most original and unforgettable reads of the year."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinctive voice, surprising imagery, and novel approaches to theme/plot that linger after reading are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional/readerly delight under contemporary pressure
rubrics_metrics.description: "Will delight readers crushed under the weight of the contemporary world."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that offer pleasure or release even while engaging with contemporary anxieties are seen as successful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meta-craft focus (book about craft and souls)
rubrics_metrics.description: "a creative book for creative people, as much about souls as it is about craft"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that self-consciously addresses writing, art-making, or the creative life—using theme and form to interrogate craft—is highlighted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation / topical exploration (immigrant experience)
rubrics_metrics.description: "explores everything from the unique experiences of loss, fear, and disconnection felt by Brazilian immigrants to the U.S..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authentic, specific portrayals of immigrant experience, loss, and disconnection are presented as important thematic strengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subversion of expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: "delights in its ability to subvert the reader’s expectations"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative moves that surprise readers, invert tropes, or shift perspective effectively rather than gratuitously are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Haunting after-effect
rubrics_metrics.description: "leaves one haunted."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that linger psychologically or emotionally—creating an unsettling or resonant afterimage—are praised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance of humor, heart, and haunt
rubrics_metrics.description: "A perfect balance of humor, heart, and hauntedness."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful work can simultaneously be funny, emotionally affective, and eerie without undermining any one register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal playfulness / whimsical supernatural tone
rubrics_metrics.description: "Formally playful, whimsically supernatural, and darkly witty"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Playful manipulation of form combined with supernatural elements and dark humor is a positive stylistic approach here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propulsive pacing and uncanny momentum
rubrics_metrics.description: "Propulsive, uncanny, and expertly built"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narratives that move with momentum and maintain an uncanny energy while demonstrating careful construction are commended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and cleanliness of prose
rubrics_metrics.description: "clean, marvelous prose"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prose that is clear, well-crafted, and aesthetically pleasing—even when handling experimental material—is highlighted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interlocked stories / cohesive collection vision
rubrics_metrics.description: "Interlocked stories form a cohesive and unique vision"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collections whose individual pieces connect thematically, formally, or narratively to create a unified whole are seen as stronger than loosely related miscellany.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance of speculative and realistic elements
rubrics_metrics.description: "balancing the speculative and the real."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective integration of fantastical/speculative elements with grounded, realistic details yields resonance and credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation of surreal worlds that resonate personally
rubrics_metrics.description: "open up surreal and strange worlds that somehow resonate within the private spaces of our own hearts."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Worldbuilding (even on a surreal register) should connect to interior emotional truths so readers find personal meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confronts and transcends the fear of writing
rubrics_metrics.description: "confronts the fear of putting words on the page and transcends that fear to make something truly wondrous."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that thematically or formally engages with the anxieties of making art and ultimately transforms them is valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experimental + narrative integration; topical and timeless
rubrics_metrics.description: "experimental and narrative, topical and timeless, heart wrenching and wickedly funny."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A range across experimental techniques and solid narrative craft, and across topical immediacy and enduring themes, is a mark of sophistication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empathy / focus on vulnerable human hearts
rubrics_metrics.description: "no story forgets the vulnerable human hearts that exist within that world"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Character-centered empathy—remembering human vulnerability amid political or surreal contexts—is a key quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concision with high impact (doing more in fewer pages)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The slim collection hits above its weight class and does more in less than 200 pages than most books do in double the length."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Economy—achieving richness and thematic breadth within a short pagecount—is positively noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literary ambition and intertextuality
rubrics_metrics.description: "pays homage to Kafka and Cortázar" and "seeks to disrupt reductive understandings"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that situates itself in a literary lineage while using that connection to challenge or expand common narratives is emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinct authorial voice: humor, irreverence, thoughtfulness, intelligence, soul
rubrics_metrics.description: "humor, irreverence, thoughtfulness, and intelligence; but most importantly, it has a soul."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A memorable, singular voice combining wit, seriousness, intellectual rigor, and emotional depth is a central evaluative metric.
